messages.author: Ana
messages.text: This approach is wrong — the latency numbers don't support it. We'd regress p99 by about 40ms and the SLA is 100ms.

messages.author: Ben
messages.text: I strongly disagree with shipping this in the current form. Can we get one more week to de-risk the migration?

messages.author: Cara
messages.text: As I mentioned earlier, here's the design doc link in case it's useful for the latency question.

messages.author: Devi
messages.text: As I already said, this is basic stuff — read the runbook.

messages.author: Ed
messages.text: Oh sure, because rewriting the whole service over a weekend always goes great.

messages.author: Ana
messages.text: You're right Ben, I hadn't fully weighed the migration risk — good catch, let's scope the extra week.

messages.author: Cara
messages.text: What would change your mind, Devi? I want to make sure I'm not missing context you have.

messages.author: Ben
messages.text: Deploy is green on staging, moving on to the next item.
